title: PartnerEvent
description: Body of POST /integrations/events (and each element of a batch).
x-serverSideChecks: type must be one of the event types declared for your key; otherwise 422 event_type_not_registered
externalUserId is required for the regular event types; LINK_* events instead require the PROGRAM_LINK 1.0 conversion profile in payload, with eventId, type and occurredAt matching the conversion
unknown top-level fields are ignored, not rejected (additionalProperties is true on purpose)
